verdict.rationale: mise is a dev-tool, environment and task manager, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that calls tools from plugged-in MCP servers is outside its product type. The evidence describes only the opposite role: `mise mcp` runs an MCP server for AI assistants. That server mode does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
